name: Matsubara Mio
source:
The protagonist’s cousin.
The daughter of Kasumi Matsubara.
Since her father is rarely home, she grew up in a single-mother household.
She's an energetic and cheerful girl who loves sports.
She struggles a bit with her studies.
She looks up to the protagonist, who excels in school, and treats him like an older brother.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/kasumi/cg/tachi/mio.html]official site[/url]]
